# `lexml-proposed/` — generated schemas, not upstream

**Do not edit the `.xsd` files here by hand.** They are generated by
`scripts/build_proposed_schemas.py` from `lexml/`.

## What this is

A local copy of the LexML schemas carrying the maintainers' proposed change
making `AgrupamentoHierarquico` a prose-bearing recursive container, so
non-articulated documents can express real hierarchy.

The change is **not yet released** in the official LexML repository. The LexML
team has indicated it is coming. This directory exists so the nested emitter can
be implemented and non-articulated documents processed in the meantime, without
waiting on the upstream release.

## The change

One edit, to `lexml-base.xsd`:

```xml
<!-- from -->
<xsd:extension base="hierarchy">
  <xsd:sequence>
    <xsd:group ref="LXhierCompleto" minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="unbounded"/>
  </xsd:sequence>
  <xsd:attributeGroup ref="nome"/>
</xsd:extension>

<!-- to -->
<xsd:extension base="hierarchy">
  <xsd:choice minOccurs="1" maxOccurs="unbounded">
    <xsd:group ref="LXhierCompleto"/>
    <xsd:element ref="Agrupamento"/>
    <xsd:element ref="Bloco"/>
  </xsd:choice>
  <xsd:attributeGroup ref="nome"/>
</xsd:extension>
```

Verified backward compatible: all 16 cases of the plan's §2.1 encoding matrix
return identical verdicts under `lexml/` and `lexml-proposed/`.

## Usage

```bash
python3 scripts/build_proposed_schemas.py           # regenerate
python3 scripts/build_proposed_schemas.py --check   # verify current, write nothing
```

`lexml/` is never modified — it stays byte-identical to upstream so schema drift
stays detectable. Regeneration replaces only `*.xsd`, so this README survives.

## Three constraints the emitter must respect

Measured against these schemas, not assumed:

1. **Subsections before own prose.** Because `AgrupamentoHierarquico` extends
   `hierarchy`, whose base sequence ends with `AgrupamentoHierarquico*`, XSD
   appends the new `choice` after it. A section's child sections must be
   serialised *before* its own `Agrupamento` prose block. Natural reading order
   (intro text, then subsections) is **rejected**.
2. **Every `AgrupamentoHierarquico` needs at least one non-`AH` child**
   (`minOccurs="1"`), and an empty `<Agrupamento/>` is itself invalid. A section
   with subsections but no prose of its own needs a marker such as
   `<Bloco nome="vazio"/>`, which is valid.
3. **Prose always needs an `Agrupamento` wrapper** — bare `<p>` directly under
   an `AgrupamentoHierarquico` is not permitted.

## When upstream ships the change

1. Re-vendor `lexml/` from the official repository.
2. Run `python3 scripts/build_proposed_schemas.py --check` — the patch will fail
   to apply, because the region it targets no longer matches. That failure is
   the signal.
3. Delete this directory and `scripts/build_proposed_schemas.py`, and point
   validation back at `lexml/` alone.
